name: HokMind
summary: HokMind develops biomimetic interactive robots that give digital characters a physical form. The company combines robot structures, facial control, artificial intelligence, character design and biomimetic materials for expressive interaction. Its Primal product series includes desktop and full-body platforms for entertainment, brand presentation and immersive experiences. The legal company is registered under a Beijing name; its corporate website also identifies Shanghai as an operating location.
